name: agent-team
description: Product delivery with a team of agents in specialised roles, in Claude Code, Codex or any agent CLI: one coordinator window running each card as a background executor that ends with an outcome in the card, authority tiers, the card as the portable unit, evidence-gated acceptance, handoffs sufficient to resume, product-versus-mechanics signals, per-client runtime profiles — with Claude Code hook templates: per-role write barrier and its test, session briefing, context guard, output filter.
